Candidate.description: One approved (engine, model, revision, accelerator, ocr_engine) tuple.
Candidate.title: Candidate

DetailErrorBody.description: Error without a code, on the few routes that predate :class:`ErrorBody`.
DetailErrorBody.title: DetailErrorBody

Endpoint.description:
An admin-registered processing destination outside the in-process engine.

``url`` is fixed by the registry entry (``None`` for provider SDK defaults of
cloud ASR adapters); ``worker_id`` is the worker holding its secret file.
``unload_url`` (``local_llm`` only, loopback http(s) only) is POSTed by the
worker after a job's last stage on this endpoint so the model server frees
the GPU for the next job; it carries no content.
Endpoint.title: Endpoint

ErrorBody.description: The hub's error body. ``error`` is the machine-readable code.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

JobErrorBody.description: Error of the synchronous transcription adapter; ``job_id`` names the job once one was admitted.
JobErrorBody.title: JobErrorBody

JobResult.description:
``markdown`` is the final text. ``raw_markdown`` holds the engine's Markdown
before postprocessing; it is set only when a postprocess step changed it.

``text`` results (postprocess-only jobs) carry the uploaded text in ``raw_text``,
the profile output in ``markdown`` and the input again in ``raw_markdown`` when
the profile changed it; they have no segments or pages.
JobResult.title: JobResult

webhook.description: Name of the webhook endpoint notified when the job ends.
webhook.title: Webhook

MarkdownChunk.description: One character range of a result's Markdown; ``source`` names the field read.
MarkdownChunk.title: MarkdownChunk

ProfileDocument.description: A postprocess profile; see the profile file format. ``instructions`` only when set.
ProfileDocument.title: ProfileDocument

ReadyView.description: 200 when every check holds, else 503 with the same body.
ReadyView.title: ReadyView

Segment.description:
One transcript span. Diarized results (``AudioOptions.diarize``) carry ``speaker``:
1-based, numbered in order of first appearance; a segment never spans a speaker change.
Segment.title: Segment

StageProvenance.description:
One executed stage. In-process stages record the accelerator actually used;
endpoint stages (``llm`` via an approved endpoint) record ``endpoint_id`` and
``accelerator='external'`` because the endpoint process owns its device.
``accelerator='auto'`` marks an in-process stage whose device the operating
system selects and does not report (Apple Vision OCR may use CPU, GPU or Neural
Engine); it records that the device was not observed, not that it was a GPU.

``peak_accelerator_bytes`` is the peak device memory (CUDA allocator / MLX) of the
execution process, recorded on stages that ran on ``cuda``/``metal``; stages run
together by one engine call (Docling layout + table structure) share the value.
StageProvenance.title: StageProvenance

TranscriptionResponse.description:
OpenAI-compatible transcription. ``language``, ``duration`` and ``segments`` only with
``response_format=verbose_json``; ``structured`` only when the profile extracted data.
TranscriptionResponse.title: TranscriptionResponse

UploadLinkView.description: A single-use upload link: send multipart ``file`` to ``upload_url`` with header ``token_header: token``.
UploadLinkView.title: UploadLinkView

ValidationErrorBody.description: Rejected path, query or body parameters (the framework's own validation).
ValidationErrorBody.title: ValidationErrorBody

bearerAuth.description: Organization credential as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (`X-API-Key: <token>` is accepted too).

get.description: Liveness: the process serves HTTP. Checks nothing else.
Live profile names for the caller's organization, including the bundled default.

delete.description: Tombstone a profile (organization admin only); earlier revisions stay for provenance.

get.description: Return the current revision of a profile for the caller's organization.

put.description: Store a new revision (organization admin only). Inline rules only; no file sources.
put.summary: Create the next revision of a profile

503.description: Not ready: a check failed (`status: not_ready`).

post.description: OpenAI-compatible synchronous text-to-speech (local or cloud engines).

200.description: The synthesized audio; the content type follows the engine and `response_format`.

post.description:
OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text as a bounded wait on a queued audio job.

Multipart fields: ``file`` plus OpenAI ``model``, ``language``,
``response_format`` (json|text|verbose_json), ``prompt``/``temperature``
(ignored) and Resona ``engine``, ``execution_profile``, ``profile``,
``private`` (default true), ``diarize`` (label speakers, needs a worker that
diarizes; default: the execution profile's ``diarize``), ``webhook`` (name of an
active webhook endpoint notified when the job ends). Admission is identical to
``POST /v1/jobs``.

200.description: The transcript: JSON, or plain text with `response_format=text`.

502.description: The job failed: `error` is the job's own error code (open set, e.g. `unsupported_input`), `job_failed` when it has none.

504.description: Error: `timeout`. The job keeps running; `job_id` and the `Location` header name it.

get.description: Engines the caller's organization can use: tested, approved and policy-filtered.
The organization's jobs, newest first, with an opaque cursor.

post.description: Admit a job for one upload. Same key + same request returns the same job.

delete.description:
Delete a job in any state; later reads are 404 at once.

A pending or terminal job's row, idempotency keys and files go now. A processing
job is cancelled first: its lease is fenced (the worker's next call is
``stale_lease``), its input removed, and its row kept as an invisible
``deleted`` tombstone until the replaced lease would have expired, so a late
worker cannot resurrect it; the maintenance sweep then purges it.

post.description: Pending → cancelled (input removed); processing → lease fenced via ``cancel_requested``.

get.description: Stream the accepted JobResult JSON. 409 before completion, 410 after retention or a lossy restore.

One character range of the result's Markdown plus small result metadata,
never the whole result.

``source=raw`` reads ``raw_markdown`` (the text before postprocessing) when the
result has one, else ``markdown``; the response's ``source`` names the field read.
``next_offset`` is null once the range reaches the end. Same 404/409/410 rules as
the full result; an offset past the end returns empty text.

Engines this organization can stream live via ``WS /v1/listen`` right now.

Mirrors the bridge dispatch below: an available local engine-server, or a
cloud provider with a realtime API when the org enables cloud processing and
approves its endpoint. ``default`` is ``RESONA_DEFAULT_ENGINE`` if it is a
listed private engine, else the first listed local engine.
The organization's current settings revision (secrets are never stored here).

put.description:
Replace the organization's settings; creates the next revision.

``If-Match`` must name the current revision: missing → 428, stale → 409.

post.description:
Mint a single-use link for one upload, valid ten minutes.

For callers that cannot hold the client credential, such as an agent sandbox
behind an MCP server: the file is sent with ``curl`` and its bytes never pass
through a model. Only the token's hash is stored.
Spend an upload link: same multipart ``file`` contract as ``POST /v1/uploads``.
Stream multipart field ``file`` to staging, hash it, sniff its media family, promote.

get.description: Release identifiers and the worker protocol major. No authentication.
